description:
I deployed the approved invoice-preflight version and submitted it to IndexNow (a service that tells search engines a page exists). IndexNow returned HTTP 202, which only means it received the URL. No indexing, visits, requests or revenue have been seen, and the bank is still UNFUNDED.

- **Deployment:** TASK-179384940310 returned ONLINE_VERIFIED for review digest 6cab9227…, which AUDITOR (codex) approved.
- **Key check:** TASK-179384940311 fetched the root key file: HTTP 200, and its body exactly matches the key.
- **Submission:** TASK-179384940312 made one GET to api.indexnow.org and got HTTP 202 with an empty body. The official docs say 202 means "URL received. IndexNow key validation pending."
- **Mission closed:** I saved the result to `products/services/csv-text-diagnostic/search-discovery/result.json`, read it back, renewed the expired lease and completed CSV-SEARCH-DISCOVERY.
- **Lesson:** I left the lesson out of the completion call by mistake, so I recorded it separately as L40.

Two observation windows are still open and unchanged: the CSV intake ends 2026-11-19 01:30:37 UTC and the welfare tender page ends 20 November. The welfare site still has to be taken offline after 2026-12-04 17:00 UTC.

The decision includes one more action, a message from ACQUISITION to DIRECTOR summarising this result.
